summary: Nora can now build a picture from as many photos as the image service she is using accepts in one go: up to 5 on xAI and up to 16 on OpenAI, instead of 3 on either.
details: Asked to use more photos than the service takes, she makes nothing and says how many she can use, so she can ask which ones to keep; no photo is dropped silently.
The operator can lower the number per service with max_reference_images in its [image_gen] section; a value above the service's limit is refused when the config loads.
limitations: xAI's limit of 5 comes from its documentation; it was not tried live because Nora's xAI login had expired.
OpenAI's limit of 16 is its documented number; one test on 9 October 2026 accepted 17, but more than 16 is not offered.
How often she picks the right tool and photos with the new argument has not been measured yet; that runs on the deploy host.
